seoTitle: Sunrise and Sunset Calculator by Latitude, Longitude and Date
metaDescription: Compute sunrise, sunset, solar noon and day length offline for any coordinates and date. Free, no data sent.
intro: Calculates sunrise, solar noon, sunset and day length for coordinates and a date with the NOAA solar equations, shown in a time zone you choose.
why:
Many sunrise sites call a weather API. This one calculates it on your device from latitude, longitude and date, so you can use it anywhere.

It matches the astral library within about 1 minute on nine test locations. Real times vary with weather, altitude and the horizon. Use east-positive longitude.
howTo: Pick a date and the time zone to show.
Read sunrise, sunset and day length.

faq.q: Can it find a place by name?
faq.a: No, that needs a lookup service. Enter coordinates from a map.
About a minute against astral at mid-latitudes; less reliable near the poles.
It tells you when the sun stays up or down all day.
